title: MedVision-AI Experiment Manifest
description: Schema for an experiment manifest used by run_experiment.py and downstream audit tooling. A manifest fully describes the inputs, parameters, and outputs expected for a single tracked run.

description.description: Long-form description of the experiment's intent.

entrypoint.description: Dotted path module:attr entrypoint for the experiment runner.

experiment.description: MLflow experiment name (a logical container for related runs).

run_name.description: Optional explicit run name; auto-generated when null.

config.description: Path to an optional YAML config file with additional parameters.

params.description: Hyperparameters and constants to log to MLflow.

tags.description: Tags applied to the run (project, team, etc.).

autolog.description: Whether to enable MLflow framework autologging.

dataset.description: Dataset reference(s) consumed by this experiment.

checksum.description: SHA256 checksum of the dataset artifact.

metrics.description: Names of metrics that this experiment is expected to log.
